verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a hosted database SaaS with AI features (MCP server, Insights computed from production traffic, agents), so an AI-training data-use control or policy is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use policy. The Insights and BYOC (PlanetScale Managed) mentions are adjacent topics and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
